sources.snippet: We examine the cost-performance landscape of Large Language Model (LLM) inference across two GPU tiers: Nvidia's enterprise-class H100 and the widely available consumer-grade RTX 4090. We benchmark latency, tokens per second, and cost per million tokens for models spanning 1.5 billion to 70 billion parameters, then zoom in on a 14 billion parameter model for a detailed comparison. sources.title: Removable and Irreducible: A Token-Cost Ledger for the Multilingual Tokenization Tax
sources.snippet: Large language models pay a well-documented tax on non-English text: the same content costs several times more tokens, and because attention is quadratic in sequence length, far more compute. We ask how much of this tax is removable.
